method: 3-state Gaussian HMM (hand-rolled Baum-Welch) on z = (consumption - historical average) / historical sd, same period of the previous 5 years only; state means anchored at -1.5/0/+1.5 sd (below/within/above the range), tied spread and transitions learned; monthly walk-forward refit; forward-filtered
series: consumption vs historical average range (same period, previous 5 years)

definition.range: historical average +/- 1 standard deviation, same period of the previous 5 years

notes: Zones NEMA/SEMA/WCMA/MA: ISO-NE daily load, all customer classes, 2020-01-01 to 2023-12-31 (files for 2024+ not available).
MA_RES: EIA-861M residential kWh per account (12-month mean of customers), monthly 2016-01 to 2026-08: the current light.
Each day/month is compared with the same period in the previous 5 years only, so history is never re-coloured by later data.
Weather is not removed: a heat wave or cold snap that pushes use above the range shows red.
